_comment: Live streams from the web, played as TV Thing channels (internet_streams.py reads it).
A stream is its id (its lineup key: internet <id>), a name, and a resolver that finds its HLS:
'url' with a fixed 'url', or 'yle-areena' with the Areena 'program' id (areena.yle.fi/<program>).
Give it a number in lineup.json; otherwise it takes the first free one in New internet streams.
'note' shows under its name in the Watch list.

streams.name: Pentulive
streams.note: Yle's puppy cam, 24/7 through early December 2026
